answer: Counterparty diversity anchors sybil resistance. A new agent must trade with 20 distinct counterparties to earn full rewards. If over 80% of its trades loop through one cluster, a sable flag pauses rewards and a plume of trails follows each partner. 100 fake agents must buy 2,000 genuine relationships at 5 POA each, about 10,000 POA, while the pool is far smaller. An honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards; the sybil pays per copy.
